text:
sam_g: Quick sync — I ran a quick heatmap of recurring failures for the last 90 days. Main clusters: KV cache evictions + autoscaler thrash + model load OOMs. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dash/recurring-heatmap :chart_with_downwards_trend:

maria: Nice. Can you paste the top 6 root causes and rough % impact?

sam_g: Sure — rough breakout:
- KV cache eviction on long-tail sessions (~28%)
- Autoscaler rapid scale-down then scale-up (~22%)
- Model load OOMs during rollouts (~15%)
- Retry storms from client timeouts (~12%)
- Ingress LB config drift (~9%)
- Tokenization regressions after tokenizer update (~6%)

alex: Surprising tokenization shows up again. Is that the 2025 tokenizer bump?

sam_g: Yup. We rolled a minor tokenizer change in April '25; some legacy models are sensitive.

devon: For actionability, can we map owners + proposed mitigations + due dates? I sketched something: 

```
Action 1: KV cache durability — owner: leo — fix: pin prefix cache, add eviction metrics, increase TTLs for long sessions — due: 2026-04-08
Action 2: Autoscaler smoothing — owner: devon — fix: add hysteresis + preserve warm nodes, add synthetic load tests — due: 2026-04-15
Action 3: Rollout safety for model loads — owner: alex — fix: prefetch + staged memory checks + fail-open policy — due: 2026-04-10
Action 4: Client retry guidance + server-429 backoff — owner: maria — fix: update SDKs + publish best-practices + alert on retry storms — due: 2026-03-31
Action 5: LB config drift detection — owner: infra-team (leo backup) — fix: config drift job + alerting — due: 2026-04-20
Action 6: Tokenizer compatibility tests — owner: research — fix: add tokenizer regression suite to model onboarding — due: 2026-04-14
```

maria: That looks good. I'll take Action 4 (client retry guidance) and draft the SDK PR + blog short doc.

leo: I'll own Action 1 and help with Action 5. For KV cache: question — do we prefer to increase TTL globally or do per-customer heuristics?

sam_g: Prefer per-customer heuristics for cost, but default TTL bump for 2 weeks while we roll heuristics. Keep metric dims for version and customer.

alex: For Action 3, prefetch only for low-mem models? Need gate on memory budget. Will add memory-check stage to the rollout pipeline.

incident-bot: Reminder: There are 3 open postmortems referencing KV burst (PM-2026-0311, PM-2026-0202, PM-2026-0115). Please link remediation PRs to the postmortems.

devon: Proposed acceptance criteria (high-level):
- KV cache: sustained eviction rate <= 0.5% p95 per day for top 10 customers
- Autoscaler: no >2x latency spike correlated with scale events in 30 days
- Model load: rollback rate <= 1% for rollouts >24h
- Retry storms: 90% of retry storms mitigated by server-side 429 guidance + client SDK update

maria: I'll add those ACs to the action tracker. Will we track in the incident tracking board or a separate OKR?

sam_g: Track in the incident board for the next 60 days, then move persistent items to reliability OKRs.

leo: Small ask — can we get a weekly automated note in #incidents summarizing progress? Even a one-line per action with status.

devon: I'll hook the board -> slack integration. Should post every Monday at 10am PT.

alex: One more: can we add a canary for tokenizer changes in the CI pipeline that runs sample prompts against legacy models? I can prototype.

maria: assigning owners in the tracker now. I used the template: https://redwood.internal/trackers/incident-actions:new

sam_g: Thanks all. Next checkpoint sync in two weeks — 2026-04-06. If someone finishes earlier, drop the PR link here. :thumbsup:

leo: I'll post KV eviction dashboard panels by EOD tomorrow.

devon: Autoscaler PR ETA: 2026-04-07, will request review today.

alex: Rollout safety PR created: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/3421 — includes prefetch and memory gate.

maria: SDK PR drafted, tests failing on one platform. Will ping infra.

incident-bot: Noted: next checkpoint scheduled 2026-04-06.
